template: In this folder, write solution.py containing the function `{signature}` that {goal}. Use the polars library that is installed (version 2.0.0). Check your function by running a quick example with python3 before finishing.

returns df with the String column "t" (format HH:MM:SS) converted to the Time dtype
adds a UInt32 column "code" holding the physical integer code of the Categorical column "site"
turns a UInt32 Series of integer codes into an Enum Series over `labels` (code 0 -> labels[0], 1 -> labels[1], ...)
returns the sample standard deviation, in seconds as a float, of the Duration column "rtt"
concatenates the two frames horizontally (their column names never clash) even when they have different heights, padding the shorter one with nulls at the bottom
explodes the list column "tags" into one row per tag, keeping exactly one row with a null tag for every device whose tag list is empty
parses headerless CSV text whose columns are interface, rx_bytes, tx_bytes (in that order) and returns the sum of rx_bytes
